name: 96019 · Shasta Lake, CA
findings: ZIP 96019 (Shasta Lake) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
